{{Quote|The Empire will come in earnest, now. This doesn't fit Malora's pattern&hellip;she never bothered to disable enemy communications during her siege of Nantoon&hellip;|Jedi Master Gnost-Dural|<ref name="Jedi Under Siege">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=general|Jedi Under Siege|Ossus}}</ref>}}
'''Nantoon''' was a location in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Jedi Under Siege" /> Some time before [[3628 BBY]],<ref name="TORDate">{{TOR_updates|5.10.0}}</ref> the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] led by [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] and [[Dark Council]]or [[Darth Malora]] [[Siege of Nantoon|besieged]] Nantoon. During the siege, [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Malora didn't bother to disable the enemy communications, a fact that [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]] recalled during the [[Invasion of Ossus]].<ref name="Jedi Under Siege" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nantoon was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity in [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', specifically the<ref name="Jedi Under Siege" /> [[2018]]<ref name="JUS Release Date">{{TORweb|url=info/news/news-article/20181211-0|text='Jedi Under Siege' Update – Play Now!}}</ref> 5.10 ''Jedi Under Siege'' update to the [[2016]] [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|''Knights of the Eternal Throne'']] expansion. Nantoon is only mentioned if the player's character, known [[in-universe]] as the [[Alliance Commander]], is among the character classes originally aligned with the Republic.<ref name="Jedi Under Siege" /> [[Nantoon]] was originally introduced in the [[2015]] [[canon]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']], the first installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[sequel trilogy]].<ref name="TFA">{{Film|VII}}</ref>
